name: @codeatlas/dashboard
description: CodeAtlas dashboard. Map types are generated from the published contract (contract/map.schema.json); run `npm run generate` after the schema changes.

scripts.generate: json2ts --input ../contract/map.schema.json --output src/map.generated.ts --bannerComment "/* Generated from contract/map.schema.json by json-schema-to-typescript. DO NOT EDIT — run \`npm run generate\` in dashboard/. */" --additionalProperties false
